base: Photorealistic street fashion photograph taken in the Bronx, New York. A very tall Black man with deep dark skin and heavily tattooed forearms, hands and neck, {look}, wearing a completely plain blank crisp white heavyweight cotton t-shirt, oversized 2XL boxy fit with dropped shoulders, wide short sleeves past the elbow and the hem falling just below the hips, the shirt has no logo, no print and no text, {bottoms}. He stands upright facing the camera with a confident streetwear attitude, arms relaxed at his sides and away from his torso, nothing covering the front of the shirt. Bare neckline: no chains, necklaces or pendants of any kind. {scene}. Shot on a 50mm lens at eye level, sharp focus, natural light, editorial streetwear lookbook quality, vertical frame with the model centred from head to mid-shin.
